approved_scope_change: User explicitly approved symptom and cause/effect fidelity instead of electron-level simulation on 2026-10-15. V2 supersedes scientific V1 as the game completion standard.
policy: Keep EC-01 through EC-09 fixed. Close only against the criteria below with checked-in regression evidence and passing game CI. New fidelity work needs a separate explicit scope decision. A closed package is reopened only by a regression against these criteria.
fidelity: Source-informed controls, plausible service readings, coherent symptoms and repeatable repair outcomes from one deterministic model. Readings are game approximations, not historical calibration.
optional_research: Exact undocumented socket wiring, lead dress and winding parameters

packages.title: Source and presentation
packages.acceptance: Resolve the displayed #8 variant, diode labels and oscillator symbol without presenting unknown physical wiring as fact.
packages.remaining: None within the fixed V2 acceptance. Named 0.05 uF game variant, functional diode labels and oscillator assembly with unknown physical mapping explicitly retained; Service data and PT44_Service_Scope_V1.json.

packages.title: Component behavior
packages.acceptance: All purchasable component classes have declared healthy, wrong-value, missing and failed behavior with bounded service parameters.
packages.remaining: None within the fixed V2 acceptance. 352 compatible catalog placements, all component classes, missing/failed states and wrong-kind guards; shared testers and wound field assembly presentation.

packages.title: Power and operating states
packages.acceptance: Warmup, series-heater failure, AC/DC supply, residual charge and damaging faults behave consistently across tools and repair guards.
packages.remaining: None within the fixed V2 acceptance. Live warmup, series heaters, hot switch-off, retained checkout charge, discharge and damaging-fault cascade; AC/DC supply envelope.

packages.title: Playable audio chain
packages.acceptance: Volume, audio tube, coupling, bias, transformer and speaker faults change sound, tracer and readings consistently; correct replacements restore checkout.
packages.remaining: None within the fixed V2 acceptance. v0.63 audio acceptance retained; complete stock fault and real-shop replacement matrix in v0.64.

packages.title: IF, detector and AVC
packages.acceptance: 455 kHz selectivity, three IF controls, detector strength, AVC attack/release and loaded probing support diagnosis and repeatable alignment recovery.
packages.remaining: None within the fixed V2 acceptance. 455 kHz selectivity, combined IF/detector failures, independent upstream tracer, timed AVC/loaded probing and manual three-control alignment recovery.

packages.title: RF and converter
packages.acceptance: 540–1600 kHz high-side tuning maintains the 455 kHz relationship; dead/weak converter, oscillator faults, loop loss and trim errors are diagnosable and recover through repair/alignment.
packages.remaining: None within the fixed V2 acceptance. v0.63 RF/converter acceptance retained; stock converter/oscillator repairs, wrong oscillator capacitor and full-band conversion regression.

packages.title: Service instruments
packages.acceptance: Meters, generator, tracer and component testers agree on loaded service conditions, ranges, polarity and injection boundaries.
packages.remaining: None within the fixed V2 acceptance. Shared tube/cap tester properties, pulled-part guard, every service-port load, meter range/polarity/live-ohms checks, generator/tracer and corrected reference conditions.

packages.title: Physical service workflow
packages.acceptance: Every supported repair has an understandable part/location, valid access and installation action; powered/charged work is guarded.
packages.remaining: None within the fixed V2 acceptance. Every supported slot has a named service location, camera-independent selector, highlight and DOM remove/install action; live/charged guards and keyed field assembly.

packages.title: End-to-end benchmark
packages.acceptance: Healthy reference and every supported stock fault can be diagnosed, repaired and checked out through the saved playable workflow; incorrect repair fails.
packages.remaining: None within the fixed V2 acceptance. All 20 stock faults through browser save/load, diagnosis, incorrect-repair checkout, part replacement and successful checkout; healthy reference, all-slot access and cascade repair.

version_support.scope: Physical component selection on the 3D chassis and tray; contextual service actions and physical meter posts; unchanged receiver, damage rules and fixed V2 acceptance.
